acceptance: using rho_prime=-3H W and q_pref=q_N-a W B, prove delta_mu_pref=mu_hat+3 W psi_pref exactly
using p_prime=-3H C, prove delta_p_pref=p_hat+3 C psi_pref exactly
prove the same ordinary-only identity deltaH0_pref=h_hat+3 W0 psi_pref
insert deltaH0_pref into psi_pref=K deltaH0_pref and derive D_A psi_pref=K h_hat with D_A=1-3 K W0
prove K<0 and therefore D_A>1 for k>0, M_c>0, a>0 and W0>0; no finite-k dressed-A denominator pole exists in this domain
derive the ordinary aggregate dressed A-source continuity h_hat_prime=-3H(h_hat+p0_hat)-(k^2/a) q0_N from physical-metric local conservation, with all Psi_N_prime terms cancelling
differentiate D_A psi=K h_hat and express psi_prime using only K,K_prime,W0,W0_prime,h_hat,h_hat_prime,psi; no B_prime or Psi_N_prime may occur
verify the exact derivative K_prime/K=2H a1_eff for constant comoving k and M_c, confirming the existing C10.52 projector K_prime formula

retain q_pref=q_N-a W B as an algebraic transform after B is solved; no temporal B initial datum is introduced
do not call this a full Boltzmann implementation or an attractor theorem
